title: DropdownMenu
summary: Menu rows are now 4px-radius pills concentric with the 8px menu (they were square). Items can be marked destructive: red label with a faint red tint on highlight. Checked rows pop their check in, and the menu now really fades, zooms and slides in as documented.
why: Task brief research summary (HeroUI, Mantine, shadcn/ui, Untitled UI, React Aria, Fluent): 'modern' here comes from connectedness and polish, not flashy motion. (Not re-researched in this pass.)
Concentric radii (inner radius = outer radius - padding): the panel is 8px with 4px padding, so rows should be 4px. Measured before: Select and Creatable rows 6px, Dropdown and SearchFilter rows 0px.
Selection feedback should be acknowledged briefly: the same fade + 85% to 100% scale as the v2 Checkbox tick, 180ms.
Task brief item 7: a destructive action should be distinguishable on highlight, not only by label colour.

scenarioLabels.03-hover-row: Open, mouse hover on a row

motion.before: opacity stayed 100%, no scale, no slide (utility-order bug)
motion.after: 200ms: opacity 0 to 100%, scale 98% to 100%, 4px slide from the trigger side, origin from Radix, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)). Exit 120ms (fade + scale 98%)
180ms opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%, spring ease (--v2-ease-spring; sampled critically damped curve, fallback cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))
instant (deliberately not animated, keyboard navigation must not lag)

states: Menu item / default, highlighted, checked, radio, submenu trigger: corner radius 0 -> 4
Menu item / destructive / highlighted: fill #FEF3F2 + label #B42318 (was #F5F5F5)
Menu item / destructive / disabled: label #A2A6B1 (disabled wins)
Checkbox and radio item / checked: check enters with scale/fade
figmaSteps: Menu (unchanged): fill #FFFFFF, border 1px #E9EAEB, corner radius 8, auto-layout padding 4, shadow 0 4 8 -2 rgba(16,24,40,0.10) + 0 2 4 -2 rgba(16,24,40,0.06), min width 128, max width 320.

Menu item, every type (item, checkbox, radio, submenu trigger): corner radius 4 (was 0). Geometry unchanged: min-height 48, padding 10 top/bottom and 6 left/right (32 left for checkbox/radio), gap 8, label 16/400 #5E5E5E, highlight fill #F5F5F5 with label #484848.

Add a boolean property Destructive on the item component. Destructive default: label #B42318 (error-700). Destructive highlighted: fill #FEF3F2 (error-50), label #B42318. Destructive disabled: label #A2A6B1 on no fill.
Checkbox/radio selected check: 16px #27ABB8, 8px from the left. Prototype: enters with opacity 0 to 100% + scale 85% to 100%, 180ms, ease cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Group label (DropdownMenuLabel): UNCHANGED: 14/500 #484848, padding 6 / 8. See notes for why it is not 12px muted.
Menu prototype: open 200ms Smart animate from opacity 0%, scale 98%, 4px offset toward the trigger, origin at the corner nearest the trigger; close 120ms opacity to 0% and scale 98%.
notes: Group label NOT unified with SelectLabel (12px / 500 / muted). design/V2-TEXT-HIERARCHY-OVERLAYS-REVIEW.md records the Dropdown section label as an 'Ordinary title / section heading' at #484848 / 500 (and rows as #5E5E5E), the user's own hierarchy decision; v2-figma-specs.md records no group-label style. Changing it to 12px muted would contradict that, so it is left as is.

Keyboard-only ring NOT added: Radix highlights by focusing the row on pointer move too, so the focus-visible pseudo-class is also true under a mouse hover (verified in Chrome: pointer-opened menu + hover still matched, and keyboard open + hover too). A reliable version needs an input-modality flag; not done.

The destructive highlight uses #FEF3F2 (semantic-error-surface, error-50). The tighter error-25 (#FFFBFA) was tried first and is nearly invisible on white. Destructive text is semantic-error-text #B42318, as the existing review records.
Row height and density are unchanged (48px).

The additive prop is destructive?: boolean on DropdownMenuItem (default false); also sets data-destructive on the item. Stories now use it instead of hand-written classes. date-range-picker's month/year menus consume DropdownMenu and are unaffected API-wise (every export and prop is unchanged).

Found while verifying motion: `motion-safe:animate-in` is emitted after bare `fade-in-0`/`zoom-in-*` classes and resets --tw-enter-opacity/--tw-enter-scale to initial, so the panel fade and 98% zoom documented in V2-MOTION.md never ran in normal-motion mode (measured at t=0: opacity 1, no scale). Fixed here by prefixing those classes with `motion-safe:` (as Checkbox/TextField already do). The same bare pattern remains in dialog.tsx, toast.tsx, tabs.tsx, date-range-picker.tsx and date-time-picker.tsx (not in this task's files, not individually verified).
